description: Election Commission - Mrs. R. P. G. Santhilatha as ceased to be a member of the United National Party - Ganga Ihala Korale Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns electoral processes under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It declares that a candidate has forfeited their rights to remain on a nomination paper for a local authority election due to ceasing membership in their political party. This content directly relates to candidate nominations and electoral administration, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
